scientific_question: Which physical predictor best explains the frequency and time-varying damping of the extracted non-QNM direct-wave component across the published SXS remnant-spin sweep?
claim_separation: a non-QNM residual is extractable under a specified filter
its instantaneous frequency and damping can be estimated under a specified model
the component is physically associated with Kerr horizon angular velocity or surface gravity
the component can be used to test Hawking's area law
